biggest_catch: The $100 referrer bonus is conditional — you only get $100 if you have SoFi Plus, an eligible direct deposit, or $5,000+ in qualifying deposits in the last 30 days; otherwise you get $75. The $25 SoFi Plus add-on is optional and requires paying $10/month — it is not free money.

Standard referrer bonus: $100 only if referrer has SoFi Plus, an eligible direct deposit, or $5,000+ qualifying deposits in the 30 days before the referral; everyone else gets $75.
Recipient gets $50; the optional $25-each SoFi Plus bonus requires the friend to subscribe to SoFi Plus ($10/month) — do not present this as no-cost earnings.
Friend must open their FIRST SoFi product via the referral link AND deposit at least $500 within 21 days of opening; the 21-day clock is strict.
Bonuses are paid within seven business days after validation, but officially no later than 74 days after the funding date — expect delays.
Total combined referral and direct-deposit bonuses capped at $10,000 per calendar year per referrer; SoFi can discontinue or change the promotion at any time.
1099 tax reporting applies; SoFi reserves the right to claw back bonuses if the referred account is closed or deemed abusive.
